design_rules: No microscope photography in student simulations.
Class 8 first: one biological idea per interaction.
Continuous motion instead of stage-to-stage teleporting.
Every animation must remain controllable: play, pause, previous, next or direct stage selection.
Color is semantic: maternal/paternal chromosomes stay consistent.
Use simplified scientific models without pretending they are literal microscope views.
Mobile controls must remain tappable and readable.
